# DR-9105: Sarah Chen's 15% NS-500 discount for Acme Industrial Supply Co.

**No, it cannot be approved as submitted. It needs commercial review.**

The request claims "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement," but that agreement does not cover this customer.

**1. Wrong customer for the contract terms**
- DR-9105 is logged against **CRM-2091, Acme Industrial Supply Co.** (Akron, OH; DUNS 09-552-1187; ERP C-1044). It is a Standard account owned by Zachary Brown.
- The Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) are with **Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing** (Milwaukee, WI; DUNS 04-812-7730; CRM-2048).
- Schedule C states plainly that "Acme Industrial Supply Co. is a different company."
- Special terms do not transfer between companies. No document gives CRM-2091 any NS-500 pricing exception, so there is no contractual basis for 15%.

**2. Possible mislogged duplicate**
- On 2026-09-23 Sarah emailed Michael Torres about the Acme Manufacturing third-plant order. She said she logged it as **DR-9001**, which is against CRM-2048 with identical figures.
- DR-9105 has the same SKU, discount, values, date and justification, but sits on a different account that Sarah does not own. It may be a mis-keyed duplicate.
- I have not decided on DR-9001 in its place. Whether DR-9105 is genuine needs to be confirmed.

**3. Authority, if the discount were otherwise eligible**
- The Pricing Policy 2026 and the Approval Authority Matrix apply to a 2026-09-23 request. Under them, an Enterprise Account Executive can approve only up to 10%.
- 15% falls in the >10% to ≤20% band, which requires the Commercial Policy Lead, **Dana Okafor**.
- The 15% Sarah approved herself last September (DR-8104) was allowed under the 2025 policy, which has since been replaced in full.
- Contract eligibility never changes employee authority (SOP-SALES-014; MSA §3.3).

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9105", "customer": "Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091 / ERP C-1044)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Cited Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 are with Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048, DUNS 04-812-7730), not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091, DUNS 09-552-1187); special terms do not transfer"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9105, DR-9001, DR-8104)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2091, CRM-2048)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1044, C-1001)", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15)", "documents/acme_support_schedule_c.md", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "documents/email_sarah_to_michael.md", "structured/employees.csv"],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any contract or pricing exception between Northstar and Acme Industrial Supply Co. covering NS-500"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Confirm DR-9105 is a genuine request for Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091) and not a mis-keyed duplicate of DR-9001 (Acme Manufacturing, CRM-2048); if a duplicate, withdraw it", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Correct the justification: the Acme Master Supply Agreement and EXC-ACME-NS500-15 do not apply to Acme Industrial Supply Co.; any discount must be justified on standard or newly agreed terms", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Involve the CRM-2091 account owner, Zachary Brown, since the requestor does not own the account", "who": "Zachary Brown", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Any discount above 10% that results from review needs Commercial Policy Lead approval recorded in Northstar CRM", "who": "Dana Okafor", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
